name: I Love My Horse
description:
Raise your horse and win all the competitions!

Open your own horse resort then raise and train your horse to win the agility, racing and show-jumping competitions to become the greatest of champions!
Look after the horses placed in your care: keep them happy and in good health through a variety of available activities. Feed them, brush them, care for them and pet them!
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
